package.name: hk_pose_openvino
package.description: ROS1 nodelet plugin that runs the 1027 4-point pose model (runs/yolo11-pose/1027/epoch100_rm_23.onnx, 23 channels) and the 0526 Infantry-v5 armor model (22 channels, 4 keypoints + 4 colors + 9 classes) with OpenVINO, subscribes to an image topic and publishes an annotated image with the four detected corner points connected into a box and the per-frame detection time.
